messages: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
#p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p411##k, the hidden leader of the city. Time to take a deep breath and go...\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I checked in on #p411#, the hidden leader of #m10003000#. Truth be told, he's someone who doesn't really need me checking in on him anyway.
name: Asking After Dark Lord
